questions.question_en: Where do the items in the agent's memory store come from in the first place?

When you ask the agent something, how does it decide which of your stored memories to pull up?
What does the system actually do to the stored information when you tell it to forget something?
What happens if you ask the agent to forget something not now but after a set period of time?
When new input matches a memory the system already holds, what does it do with the older one?
What problem with memoryless agents is this system meant to solve, and what does it claim is different about its approach?
